locator.name: names a change the reviewed task did not write with one chip that names its source

proves.facet: A mounted invariant selection with no owner judgment/meaning step and a supplied crossing-owner after writer shows one chip naming that exact source, with the supplied writer detail as its title.

locator.name: reads its subject once, reuses the cards, and scrolls the column once after the read

proves.facet: An explicit latest subject selection adds only its one intent request, reuses opening cards and stores its subject selection in the URL.

locator.name: toggles the tree with [ and the chat with ], never in a text field

proves.facet: In the actual review surface, [ in the filter leaves the tree open; [ on document.body closes it, ] invokes the supplied chat toggle, both controls have their sidebar names, and clicking the retained tree toggle reopens the tree. This proves the rendered shared-control binding and tree open-state transition; it does not measure released width, hidden-node focus or actual browser geometry.

locator.name: shows nothing for no family and keeps the provenance in the closed Technical details

proves.facet: With no family member rows and carried before r2/after r4, the selected invariant meta line reads revision 2 → 4; the Technical details fold stays closed and carries revision-id provenance.

locator.name: opens unselected with one line when a hunk names a span its file does not hold

proves.facet: A forged hunk span with matching file/tree identity is rejected; the outside-selection line appears and the crumb contains no selected lane file.

locator.name: restores a hunk its file holds on reload

proves.facet: A genuine mapped hunk span restores the lane file crumb without an outside-selection warning.

locator.name: opens unselected with one line when the selection names another comparison

proves.facet: A URL entry identity with another code candidate tree opens unselected and reports the shown comparison number.

locator.name: restores a block selection on reload

proves.facet: Reloading a comparison-bound entry URL selects a card containing that entry and shows no outside-selection warning.
